chunks: And those who undo the bonds gently,

key_terms.النَّاشِطَاتِ: Those who loosen or untie bonds

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'And those who undo the bonds gently' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase highlights the divine agency behind the movement of ships, illustrating how Allah loosens their moorings with ease to facilitate travel. It serves as a sign of God's power over nature, reminding believers that even complex mechanisms of movement are governed by His will and grace.
